sentences.text: 1  For Petitioner : Mr.K.Kannan

For Respondents : Mr.M.V.Ramachandramurthy,
 Additional Public Prosecut  Puducherry, Assisted by  Mr.A.Alexander  ORDER

This Criminal Original Petition is filed to quash the FIR registered by the Kottucherry Police Station,
Puducherry (now transferred and pending on the file of the Station House Officer, Vigilance and Anti Corruption Unit, Mahatma Gandhi Road, Muthaiyalpet, Puducherry-605 003) on 18.10.2021 for the alleged offence under Sections 34, 420, 468, 471 and 467 of IPC.
2.
This petitioner has been arrayed as sixth accused in the FIR.

On 02.12.2022, the petitioner has filed this petition to quash stating some malicious prosecution and no incriminating materials against him are available for the investigating agency to proceed with the investigation.

3. The learned Additional Public Prosecutor representing Puducherry Government has filed counter stating that on registration of FIR by Kottucherry Police, this petitioner was interrogated and based on his https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis admission and information, house search was conducted.

Incriminating materials including deposits and investments were seized from the premises on 18.10.2021.
4.
Considering the gravity of the offence and the petitioner being a public servant, case has been transferred to Vigilance and Anti-corruption vide proceedings dated 23.02.2022.
The investigation been proceeded and strong incriminating materials against this petitioner and few others been collected.
This Court on perusing the record find that there is prima facie materials to proceed with the investigation and it does not appear to be malicious prosecution for the present.
Hence, this Criminal Original Petition is dismissed.
The respondent police is directed to complete the investigation within a period of three months and file a final report.
